### D10 diagnostic (train / validation only)
Benign train: 0.83% of flows go to the web server 192.168.10.50 (8937 flows, 141 on port 80); attack validation flows: 99.75% go to it; 18.8% of the benign validation alarms of net.allow_service are flows to it. Attacker address 172.16.0.1 appears in benign train as source in 222 flows and as destination in 20910.
